bio: Annie Wenner married Frederick Meier at Hazleton on 12 May 1886, giving her birth as 15 August (year partly legible) ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch has Aug 1861. Her daughter Agnes's 1918 marriage docket names her as 'Anna, maiden name Wenner', of Hazleton, in domestic service and born at Hazleton, with Agnes's father Fred already dead ([R4-S2]). FamilySearch gives her death as 1940 ([R4-S3]).
